observations.body: Those coming to Christ as living stone are built into a spiritual house and holy priesthood to offer sacrifices acceptable through Jesus Christ.
observations.label: A living people offer spiritual sacrifices

observations.body: The passage presents living stone, built people, priesthood, spiritual sacrifices, rejected cornerstone, mercy, and proclamation as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: living stone, built people, priesthood, spiritual sacrifices, rejected cornerstone, mercy, and proclamation

observations.body: The passage places living house priesthood beside living stone, built people, priesthood, spiritual sacrifices, rejected cornerstone, mercy, and proclamation.
observations.label: living house priesthood

payload.posture: Read 1 Peter 2:1–10 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the passage names the offering community and mediator but does not list the sacrifices’ material form
payload.title: A living people offer spiritual sacrifices
